name: reaching upper back stretch
description: Reaching your arms out as you round your upper back stretches the muscles between and around your shoulder blades.
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and reach both arms forward at chest height.
Round your upper back and spread your shoulder blades apart as you reach farther.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
